# Zinc

> Keyboard-first, security-focused app-sandboxing core. Every user-facing app runs in a
> rootless Podman container (primary) or a qemu VM. Priority order: Stable, then Secure,
> then Beautiful.

The tools are `zc` (zinc-creator: authors app files of both kinds, keyboard-first TUI
+ CLI) and `zcr` (zinc-container-runner: runs an app file via rootless podman). They share
one library, `common` (the app schema + validation), and meet only at the on-disk YAML
format: zc authors and shells out to a runner binary to run. The network lock-down is
applied by nftables in the app's own netns before the app starts (fail-closed). Builds are
podman-only: all Go for the tools runs in a digest-pinned container via `make`.

`zvr` (zinc-virtualization-runner, 0.4) is the VM sibling of zcr: one store and one schema
hold both kinds, split by `Type`, and each runner refuses the other's apps by name. It drives
qemu directly rather than libvirt, so a guest's window opens in the user's own session with
GPU acceleration; the cost is that zvr owns supervision (pidfile + QMP). Guest disks are
copy-on-write over a digest-pinned base. The container network model does NOT carry over to a
guest and is rejected rather than approximated.

The launchers are `zlt` (0.2, terminal) and `zlg` (0.3, a Wayland overlay window). Both
fuzzy-pick a defined app and launch it through the `zcr` binary, sharing `launcher/common`;
neither imports the runtime. `zlg`'s window is `menu`, a standalone reusable overlay-menu
module that depends on no Zinc sibling, so other projects can import it.

## Docs

- [Architecture (single source of truth)](docs/architecture.md): the full design - schema, security and image trust, the network model, repo layout.
- [README](README.md): overview, components, install, and the podman-only build/run quickstart.
- [Roadmap](ROADMAP.md) and [Releases](RELEASES.md): what is planned and the release plan.

## Reference

- [zc README](creator/README.md): the creator - author/manage app files, the command surface, the zc/zcr split.
- [zcr README](container/runner/README.md): the runner - run an app file, the fail-closed network model.
- [zlt README](launcher/tui/README.md): the launcher TUI (0.2) - fuzzy-pick an app and launch it via zcr.
- [zlg README](launcher/gui/README.md): the launcher GUI (0.3) - the same picker as a pure-Go Wayland window.
- [menu README](menu/README.md): the reusable Wayland overlay-menu module (0.3) - list and thumbnail-grid pickers, `go get`-able on its own.

## Agent guidance

- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): how to work in this repo - golden rules, the runner hexagon, the build gate, and the security model.
